Ing.(FH) Guido Lotte   Food Technologist  Version:   01   Replaces:   -  Product information Product analysis  Product name   Boyens Glasurspray  Description   The glaze spray is a ready-to-use, immediately usable, neutral gloss spray with apricot flavour for refining fine pastries and products baked with yeast. It ís a sweet, aromatic and  pleasant way of rounding off pastries and produces a beautiful glaze on the pastry while also creating a long-lasting, crunchy freshness!  Information about usage  Shake glaze spray briefly and vigorously before use, hold can upside down with nozzle facing downwards and spray directly on to the hot pastry as required. Briefly allow to dry and you íre  done!  Ingredients   Water, sugar, glucose syrup, stabiliser: glycerine; thickening agent: pectins, preservatives: potassium sorbate, natural aroma: apricot, acidity regulator: citric acid, colouring plant extracts: turmeric / paprika. Propellant: nitrogen  Nutritional values   Calorific value / 100 g   883 kJ (208 kcal) Carbohydrates   53 g - of which sugar   45 g Fat   0 g - of which saturated fatty acids   0 g - of which Monounsaturated fatty acids   0 g - of which Polyunsaturated fatty acids   0 g Protein   0 g Fibre   0 g Salt (sodium x 2.5)   0.02 g  Microbiological data  (guideline values)  Parameters   Values   Method Total bacterial count   < 1,000 cfu / g   ß 64 Para. 1 Lebensmittel - und Futtermittelgesetzbuch (LFGB   ñ   German Food and Feed Code) Enterobacteriaceae Moulds Yeasts Salmonellae <   10 cfu / g < 100 cfu / g < 100 cfu / g n.d. / 25 g  Sensory information   Smell   Pleasant apricot fragrance Taste   Sweet apricot flavour Colour   Clear light yellowish transparent Appearance   Liquid  Packaging   400ml can, 6 cans per box  Storage   Optimum storage temperature: 15 - 20 ∞C . (Observe safety data sheets)  Shelf life   24 months in unopened containers  Safety information   Danger:   Can is pressurised: May burst when heated. Keep away from heat, hot surfaces, sparks, naked flames and other types of ignition sources. Do not smoke. Do not puncture or burn, even after use. Do not inhale aerosol. Protect from sunlight. Do not expose to temperatures higher than 50 ∞C. Disposal of the contents / container in accordance with local  regulations.  Remarks   The product is intended solely for use in commercial food processing. The data has been calculated in accordance with the food law. Fluctuations may occur as a result of the natural raw materials used. The product, including packaging, complies with the German Lebensmittel- und Bedarfsgegenst ‰ndegesetz  (LFBG   ñ   Foodstuffs and Commodities Act) and its follow-up ordinances as well as the relevant principles of the Deutsche Lebensmittelbuch (German Food Code) and EU law in their respectively applicable versions.
